description: Free. Headline facts about a Dutch neighbourhood for a postcode: residents, average home value (WOZ) and the municipality's average sale price, share of owner-occupied homes, liveability percentile, crime per 1,000 residents vs the national rate, and distance to supermarket, GP, primary school and train station. Sources: CBS, Politie, Leefbaarometer.

postcode.description: Any Dutch postcode in the neighbourhood, e.g. 2517AS
